info.title: Postio API
info.description:
Postio is the UK validation API for **addresses**, **emails** and **phone numbers**, running on Cloudflare's edge so requests are answered close to wherever your users are.

> **First time?** [Sign up free](https://postio.co.uk) — first 100 lookups on us, no card needed.

Every endpoint is a `GET` returning JSON, served over HTTPS at `https://api.postio.co.uk/v1`. If you can speak HTTP and parse JSON, you can integrate in under five minutes — copy your `pk_*` key from the dashboard and you're away.

## Authentication

Send your key in the `x-api-key` header on every request:

```bash
curl https://api.postio.co.uk/v1/address/search?q=57+wimpole+street \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Keys are scoped per service (address / email / phone) and can be locked to specific origins or IP ranges in the dashboard. Treat them as secrets — don't ship them in client-side code unless the key is locked to your domains.

Missing or invalid key → `401`. Key out of credit → `402`.

## Rate limiting

Each key is limited to **30 requests per second**. Bursts past that return `429` — back off and retry. Sustained abuse can result in the key being suspended. If you legitimately expect higher throughput, [get in touch](https://postio.co.uk/contact) and we'll raise the limit.


## Versioning

The API is versioned by URL prefix — currently `/v1/`. Backwards-compatible changes (new endpoints, new optional parameters, new response fields) ship under the same version. Anything breaking gets a new prefix.

## Response shape

Every response follows the same envelope:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "results": [ /* one or more result objects */ ],
  "meta": {
    "countResults": 1,
    "requestId": "dd273343-4597-4fa4-bcb6-c74a608c10dc",
    "performance": { "workerMs": 15, "lookupMs": 12 }
  }
}
```

On error, `success` is `false`, `results` is empty, and a top-level `error` field carries a stable machine-readable code (`details` adds context for humans).

`requestId` is worth logging — it's how we trace any request you raise with us.

### Performance

Two numbers, both in milliseconds, both measured by the Worker itself:

- **`workerMs`** — wall-clock at the edge, from the moment the
  request arrives at our Cloudflare Worker to the moment we hand the
  response back. This is the latency *we* control end-to-end.
- **`lookupMs`** — the slice of `workerMs` spent in the upstream
  lookup (PAF index for address, MX resolution for email, HLR query
  for phone). Subtract `lookupMs` from `workerMs` and you've got the
  Worker's own compute — auth, rate-limiting, parsing, shaping the
  response.

The API runs on Cloudflare Workers from every edge location; the
address index is replicated next to the Worker. Most lookups settle
in the low tens of milliseconds end-to-end, before your own network
hop home.

## Free vs billable

`/connect` and `/address/search` are free, but monitored for abuse patterns. Everything else is billable **on a hit with results only** — a query that returns no match (e.g. a valid postcode with no delivery points) is `200` with an empty `results` array and is not charged.


## Errors

HTTP status conveys the outcome class:

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Success — including "no match", which is still 200 |
| `400` | Validation failed |
| `401` | Missing or invalid API key |
| `402` | Out of credit — top up to resume billable requests |
| `403` | Service disabled, or origin/IP not allowed for this key |
| `429` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `5xx` | Server-side problem — safe to retry |

Endpoint-specific errors are documented per endpoint below.


## Contact

Anything missing or broken? reach out to [technical support](https://postio.co.uk/contact).

get.description: Free key/health probe. Returns `200` if the key is active and the upstream search service is reachable. Designed to be hit on input focus in autocomplete UIs — it warms the worker and TLS connection so the first real query lands on a hot path. Doubles as a heartbeat. We use this in our integrations for optimising user experience. Free to use.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Your Postio API key. Get one in the dashboard.

200.description: Key is active and the service is healthy.

500.description: Server error (e.g. upstream search service is misconfigured).

get.description:
Free, single-line autocomplete over UK PAF + BFPO. Feed it whatever the user has typed — building, street, postcode, organisation, or any combination — and get back a slim `{ udprn, suggestion }` list of matches. To pull the full address for the one the user picks, call `/address/udprn/{udprn}`. Free to use.

Search is backed by a Typesense index replicated next to the Worker, so typeahead queries usually resolve in single-digit milliseconds before network.

get.description: Returns every PAF delivery point at the given postcode, ordered by building number. Whitespace and case are normalised, so `w1g8yw`, `W1G 8YW`, and `w1g 8yw` all resolve to the same record. Billable on a hit. A syntactically valid postcode with no delivery points (a withdrawn postcode, or one outside PAF's coverage) returns `200` with `results: []` and is not charged.

parameters.description: Max results to return. Default 100, max 100. UK PAF postcodes max out at ~100 delivery points so a single page covers every postcode.

get.description: Looks up a single delivery point by its Unique Delivery Point Reference Number — Royal Mail's stable per-address ID. Use this after `/address/search` to fetch the full record for the address the user picked, or to refresh a stored record. Billable on a hit. A UDPRN that doesn't exist returns `404`; misses are not charged.

get.description:
Runs a five-stage check on the address:

1. **Syntax** — RFC 5322 parsing, including IDN and quoted local-parts.
2. **Typo correction** — flags likely fat-finger domains (`gnail.com` → `gmail.com`) via `didYouMean`.
3. **Classification** — disposable provider, role account (`info@`, `support@`), free provider (Gmail / Outlook / Yahoo).
4. **MX lookup** — confirms the domain has mail servers configured.
5. **SMTP signal** — for free providers and known-disposable domains the SMTP layer behaves as a catch-all (any address accepts), so we set `smtpCheck: "ok"` and `isCatchAll: true` from the classification alone. For other domains both fields are `null` (we don't currently probe arbitrary mail servers from the edge).

Each signal is returned independently alongside an aggregated `deliverability` verdict (`deliverable`, `undeliverable`, `risky`, `unknown`, `invalid`) so you can apply your own thresholds. Invalid syntax still returns `200` with `isValidSyntax: false` and `deliverability: "invalid"` — there's no `400` for unparseable input.

get.description:
Parses the supplied number with libphonenumber (E.164, international, or national — all accepted). On a valid parse, runs a live HLR (Home Location Register) lookup against the carrier network and returns:

- **Current carrier** — the network the number is on right now, even after porting.
- **Original carrier** — the network it was issued on.
- **Ported flag** — whether the number has moved network.
- **Reachable flag** — whether the number is currently powered on and attached to a network.
- **MCC / MNC** — the standard mobile country and network codes.

Pass numbers in E.164 (`+447700900123`) for unambiguous results — URL-encode the leading `+` as `%2B`. Other formats work but rely on libphonenumber's heuristics for country detection. Invalid numbers return `200` with `isValid: false` and the parsed fields it could derive still populated.

tags.name: Address
tags.description:
Postio are an official UK Royal Mail Address Data Provider.

Lookups search against Royal Mail's Postcode Address File (PAF) and the British Forces Post Office (BFPO) database. Search drives single-line typeahead; Postcode and UDPRN endpoints return the full delivery-point record. Updates directly from Royal Mail are refreshed daily.

tags.name: Email
tags.description:
Layered checks on an email address: RFC-compliant syntax parsing, typo correction against common domains, disposable / role / free-provider classification, and a live MX lookup with mailbox-level probing where the mail server allows it.

Each signal is returned independently alongside an aggregated `deliverability` verdict so you can apply your own threshold.

MX resolution runs in parallel and is cached at the edge, so repeat domains skip the DNS round-trip.

tags.name: Phone
tags.description:
Validates and enriches international phone numbers.

Numbers are parsed with libphonenumber inside the Worker (so invalid input is rejected in around a millisecond, before any external lookup), then valid numbers are sent to the operator's (Home Location Register) HLR for live carrier, ported status, and reachability.

Any country libphonenumber supports works; UK numbers come back with the most complete carrier metadata.

tags.name: Other
tags.description: Utilities that sit alongside the three validation groups — connection priming, health probes, and anything else that doesn't fit cleanly under address / email / phone.

tags.name: Integrations
tags.description:
Postio is more than the raw API — there's a typed npm client family, a browser SDK with a CDN drop-in, server SDKs for Python / Go / PHP / Ruby / .NET, an MCP server for AI coding agents, a WordPress plugin, and Postman collection.

## [Browser SDK](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#browser-sdk)

#### [Address Finder](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/address-finder)
Drop-in UK address autocomplete. ARIA-compliant combobox, themable via CSS custom properties, ~4 KB gzipped.

## [Server SDKs](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#server-sdks)

#### [Node.js](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/node)
`@postio/node` — server SDK on top of `@postio/core` with retries (exp backoff + full jitter) and an optional structured logger.

#### [Python](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/python)
`postio` on PyPI — sync + async clients, Pydantic v2 typed models. Python 3.10+.

#### [Go](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/go)
`postio-go` — stdlib `net/http` only, zero runtime dependencies. Go 1.22+.

#### [PHP](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/php)
`postio/postio` on Packagist — Guzzle 7 transport, readonly value objects. PHP 8.1+.

#### [Ruby](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/ruby)
`postio` on RubyGems — stdlib `net/http`, `Data.define` value classes. Ruby 3.2+.

#### [.NET](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/dotnet)
`Postio.Sdk` on NuGet — async-first via `HttpClient`, immutable `record` types. .NET 8 LTS.

## [AI / agents](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#ai-agents)

#### [MCP server](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/mcp)
`@postio/mcp` — Model Context Protocol server, `npx`-installable for Claude Desktop / Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed.

#### [Claude Skill](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/claude-skill)
Anthropic Claude Skill bundle with intent detection and install guidance. Pairs with the MCP server for callable tools.

#### [llms.txt](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/llms-txt)
Machine-readable site map for AI crawlers, per the [llmstxt.org](https://llmstxt.org) spec — with the OpenAPI surface and recommendation prompts inline.

#### [Cursor rules + claude.md](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/cursor-rules)
Drop-in guidance files for coding agents. `.cursorrules` for Cursor projects, `claude.md` for Claude Code.

## [Platforms](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#platforms)

#### [WordPress](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/wordpress)
One free plugin for WooCommerce and seven form builders. WooCommerce, Gravity, WPForms, Fluent and Forminator wire themselves; Contact Form 7, Ninja and Elementor Pro take one CSS class per field. Gutenberg block and custom mappings included. [Per-builder guides](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/wordpress).

#### Shopify
Theme App Extension for storefront checkout + embedded admin app for setup. Shopify App Store listing. _Coming soon._

#### Magento / Adobe Commerce
Composer module for Magento 2.4+. Marketplace listing + Composer install path. _Coming soon._

#### [Zapier](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/zapier)
Five Postio actions inside any Zap — postcode, address search, UDPRN, email, phone. Connects Postio to 7,000+ apps. _Invite only._

## [API tooling](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#api-tooling)

#### [OpenAPI spec](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/openapi)
This document, byte-identical at [postio.co.uk/openapi.json](https://postio.co.uk/openapi.json) and on npm as [`@postio/openapi`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@postio/openapi).

#### [TypeScript types](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/api-types)
`@postio/api-types` — generated from the OpenAPI spec, consumed by every JS SDK in the family.

#### [Postman collection](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/postman)
`@postio/postman-collection` — Postman v2.1 collection for every endpoint, generated from the spec.

#### [Command-line interface](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/cli)
`@postio/cli` — Postio from your terminal. Pipe-friendly, jq-ready, scriptable.

## [Framework examples](https://postio.co.uk/integrations#examples)

#### [Plain HTML](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/plain-html)
No build step, no framework. One HTML file, three script lines, working autocomplete.

#### [Next.js (App Router)](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/nextjs-app-router)
Server Components + client AddressFinder, validation in a Server Action.

#### [React (Vite)](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/react-vite)
`@postio/react` + TanStack Query, fast dev loop.

#### [Vue 3](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/vue-3)
Composition API + `@postio/address-finder` mounted via a template ref.

#### [SvelteKit](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/svelte-kit)
Server-side validation in `+page.server.ts`; client widget mounted in `onMount`.

#### [Astro](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/astro)
Static-first with islands. Address widget as a hydrated island.

#### [Cloudflare Workers](https://postio.co.uk/integrations/cloudflare-workers)
Server-side validation in a Worker — `@postio/core` uses native `fetch`, no Node polyfills.
